narration.full_text: Welcome to our lesson on trigonometry! Today, we'll cover some fundamental concepts that are crucial for understanding this branch of mathematics. Our main goals for this session are to define the six fundamental trigonometric ratios. You'll learn what each ratio represents and how they relate to the sides and angles of a right-angled triangle. We will then apply these trigonometric ratios to solve various problems involving right-angled triangles. This will help you see how these concepts are used in practical scenarios. Finally, we'll explore and understand how to use reciprocal trigonometric identities, which are essential for simplifying expressions and solving more complex trigonometric equations.
